items.title: Jim Cramer’s Top 5 Dividend Stocks for Safe, Consistent Returns
items.summary: From 2000 through 2009, dividends earned S&P 500 investors an annualized 1.8%, according to Hartford Funds. Even with those payments, the index posted a negative total return for the decade. items.title: Wall Street hits the night shift thanks to Okxice, and Kraken puts daq in your wallet
items.summary: Scott Melker discusses Okxice's plans for a Nov. 23 launch under an SEC innovation exemption; Kraken (KRAK.PVT) to launch Nasdaq-backed tokenized versions of European stocks; and Goldman Sachs (GS) and Citi (C) among the banks committing to stablecoin ventures. "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.

items.title: TRGP Q3 Earnings Beat on Permian Growth and Higher Fees
items.summary: Targa Resources' Q3 2026 earnings beat estimates as record Permian volumes and higher fees fueled growth, prompting a raised full-year EBITDA outlook.
